name: Stranger Mix
description:
While this team is a juggernaut in other game modes, it performs far less impressively in TB.
It works if Relic Delta is in play, but gets really shaky in p5-p6, and even p4 is not immune to bad RNG.
The team is just not worth the investment, unless you have them built already for other game modes.
Stranger and MHF probably perform better under SEE lead, where Stranger hits quite hard from SEE's leadership.
notes: Does not perform with stability vs. equal relic missions
